purpose: Primary-source checks for corrections from the whole-page accuracy review of the assessment page, outside candidate specifications.
researcher: Claude Code research agent, general-purpose, inherited parent model claude-opus-5-5
checker: Independent Claude Code checking agent, claude-sonnet-5
method: The researcher flagged outdated or overstated page claims and cited primary pages. The checker opened each page separately and quoted it. The parent used the checked wording.

checks.approved_wording: ESA completed Collection 1 reprocessing in two phases. Phase 1, sensing 2015 to 2021 at baseline 05.00, was fully available on 2024-09-02. Phase 2, sensing 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-13 at baseline 05.10, was announced complete on 2025-09-08. Removal of old-baseline 2022 to 2023 products began on 2025-08-12.
checks.locator: Phase 1 and Phase 2 availability news items, main body
checks.quote: from 1 January 2022 up to 13 December 2023 / reprocessing and publication activities for Sentinel-2 Collection-1 Phase-2 are completed / The deletion process of products with old baselines started on 12th August 2025
checks.qualification: Availability at the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem says nothing about the AWS copies.

checks.topic: Reflectance differences in the overlap of adjacent tiles
checks.approved_wording: In the overlap between adjacent Level-2A tiles, ESA states that aerosol optical depth and surface reflectance are generally different, although the difference should be small.
checks.quote: The Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) and surface reflectances are generally different, although the difference should be small.
checks.qualification: ESA gives no magnitude. Agreement in the overlap remains unmeasured in this assessment.

checks.topic: Resolution of the Level-2A no-data mask at swath edges
checks.approved_wording: The Level-2A no-data and detector-footprint handling at swath edges is computed at 20 m, so artifacts can appear in the 10 m bands. ESA recommends the MSK_DETFOO mask.
checks.locator: Artefacts at the edge of the swath due to L2A NoData mask
checks.quote: The nodata mask at L2A is common to all the bands and computed at 20 m resolution... the resulting common mask at 20 m is then oversampled at 10 m during the processing of 10 m bands.
checks.qualification: The checker noted that the page also describes a correction in baseline 05.13. That statement was not drafted or checked here.

checks.approved_wording: Sentinel-2A continues an extension campaign after Sentinel-2C took over its operational role in 2025. ESA prolonged the campaign until 31 December 2026.
checks.locator: S2 Mission, Sentinel-2A and 2C section, and the 2026-05-15 news item
checks.quote: Sentinel-2C has replaced Sentinel-2A in operation on January 21st, 2025 / Sentinel-2A will continue to operate under the tailored operational scenario introduced in 2025 until 31 December 2026
checks.qualification: The campaign's added coverage over the contiguous United States is not established here.

checks.topic: Maintenance status of NHD and NHDPlus HR
checks.approved_wording: USGS retired the National Hydrography Dataset on 2023-10-01. NHD data remains available but is no longer maintained. USGS halted NHDPlus HR production to focus on the 3D Hydrography Program, which will include many of NHDPlus HR's best features.
checks.locator: National Hydrography overview, NHDPlus High Resolution page, and 3D Hydrography Program page
checks.quote: As of October 1, 2023, the NHD was retired. / NHD data will continue to be available, but no longer maintained. / Production of NHDPlus HR has been halted to allow USGS to focus on the 3DHP
checks.qualification: The draft said the 3D Hydrography Program replaces both datasets. No cited page uses that word, so the approved wording drops it.

checks.approved_wording: The readme for the sentinel-s2-l2a bucket is hosted on a Sentinel Hub domain. The readme does not name its author.
checks.quote: If you have questions about the data, please use Sentinel Hub forum
checks.qualification: Hosting does not establish authorship or bucket ownership.

limitations: Documentation checks are not measurements, sensor validation, or human approval.
Researcher and checker are both Claude models. They differ by model, not by organization.
Three wording corrections in the same review needed no new source. They align summary lines with existing inventory text and evidence.
